title: 第15章 上生死台第16章 阴险偷袭
content_zh:
第15章上生死台
“不敢，不过李某也只是来提醒一声楚大管家。”
李星脸色急剧变化，不过很快他的脸色还是恢复平静了下来，显得极为阴沉道。
“楚大管家虽然已经成为武者，不过也要想清楚吗，在林府內府面前，这等实力，不过如同蝼蚁一般罢了，蜉蝣撼树，只有死路一条。”
李星话中的意思，楚风眠清楚。
那边是就算是现在楚风眠已经是成为了武者，拥有了实力，但是若是放在林府內府之中，依然算不上什么。
“李星，你也不用拐弯抹角说些什么，这些年的事，楚某也清楚，不管是你，还是你背后的人，其中的账，楚某会一一算清楚的。”
楚风眠口中冰冷的开口道。
这李星的身份虽然不低，但是以他的身份也绝不可能敢来如此处处针对楚风眠。
在这李星的背后，还有这更加强大的人，那便就是林府如今的少府主，只有他才敢真正如此针对楚风眠。
“楚风眠，你莫非真的是疯了不成？就凭你这样一个小角色，也敢想去对付林少爷？”
听到楚风眠的话，李星大笑了起来。
在这李星看来，楚风眠如今能够成为林府外府的大管家，其实也就是靠的楚风眠曾经爷爷对林府的恩惠，至于楚风眠本人，根本不被李星放在眼中。
楚风眠如今恢复灵脉，成为武者，的确是让李星极为吃惊，但是成就武者又如何，一个十八岁刚刚踏入淬骨境的武者，又能掀起什么风浪。
“楚风眠，本少只是来提醒你一声，乖乖做一个废人，也可以免受一些皮肉之苦，不然的话，倒时候受苦的人，可是你自己。”
李星冷笑道，言语之中充满着其中的威胁之意。
“楚大管家近些日子还是乖乖待在林府为好，不然的话，出去遇到一点什么闪失，可就不好了。”
开口之际，李星的眼神之中已经是露出了几分杀意。
这一抹杀意，被楚风眠看在眼中。
看得出现在李星的心中，已经是有着几分想要报复楚风眠的打算，只要是楚风眠离开林府，他便是就可以毫不顾忌的来报复楚风眠。

“李星，你以为你真的是楚某对手？”
楚风眠看向李星的表情，极为玩味。
“楚风眠，你有什么资格在这里嚣张！”
看到楚风眠的表情，李星大怒道，他对楚风眠早已经是怨恨极深，要是没有楚风眠，他早已经就是林府外府的大管家。
虽然如今他也足以称得上是林府外府的第一人，但是一个副管家的名字，可一直如同一根扎在李星手心中的一个刺，他无数不可不想要拔掉。
现在听见楚风眠的话，李星不再忍耐，直接便是怒声开口道。
“你要是有本事，就跟我去生死台上一战，倒时候谁才是林府外府第一人，自然清楚！”
“生死台！”
“这李星，竟然是要让楚风眠跟他上生死台上一战！”
庭院之中传来的响声，已经是吸引了不少林府弟子前来围观。
面对着林府大管家，副管家，几乎两位林府外府巅峰之人的一战，他们一个个也都是极为好奇，想要看看谁到底才是林府外府的第一人。
“楚风眠如今虽然是凝聚了灵脉，踏入武者，不过他凝聚灵脉最多不过几个月时间，就算是进展神速，想要跟李星一战，绝不可能。”
一名林府外府弟子摇了摇头道。
content_en:
Chapter 15: Going to the stage of life and death
"I don't dare, but Li just came to remind Butler Chu."
Li Xing's expression changed drastically, but soon his expression calmed down again, looking extremely gloomy.
"Although Butler Chu has become a warrior, he still needs to think clearly. In front of the Lin Mansion, such strength is just like an ant. A mayfly shaking a tree will only lead to death."
Chu Fengmian knew the meaning of Li Xing's words.
Over there, even though Chu Fengmian has now become a warrior and has strength, it is still nothing if placed in the inner palace of Lin Mansion.
"Li Xing, you don't need to beat around the bush. Chu knows what happened over the years. Whether it's you or the people behind you, Chu will settle the accounts one by one."
Chu Fengmian said coldly.
Although Li Xing's status was not low, he would never dare to target Chu Fengmian like this.
Behind Li Xing, there is an even more powerful person, and that is the current Young Master of the Lin Mansion. Only he dares to really target Chu Fengmian like this.
"Chu Fengmian, are you really crazy? With a small role like you, do you dare to deal with Master Lin?"
Li Xing laughed when he heard Chu Fengmian's words.
In Li Xing's opinion, Chu Fengmian's ability to become the housekeeper of the Lin Mansion was actually due to Chu Fengmian's grandfather's kindness to the Lin Mansion. As for Chu Fengmian himself, Li Xing did not take him seriously at all.
Chu Fengmian has now recovered his spiritual veins and become a warrior, which really surprised Li Xing, but what if he became a warrior? What kind of trouble can a warrior who has just stepped into the Bone Tempering Realm at the age of eighteen cause.
"Chu Fengmian, I just want to remind you that by being a disabled person, you can avoid some physical pain. Otherwise, you will be the one who suffers."
Li Xing sneered, his words full of threats.
"Butler Chu, it would be better for him to stay in the Lin Mansion these days. Otherwise, it would be bad if something goes wrong when he goes out."
When he spoke, Li Xing's eyes already showed some murderous intent.
This intention to kill was seen by Chu Fengmian.
It can be seen that Li Xing already has some plans to take revenge on Chu Fengmian in his heart. As long as Chu Fengmian leaves the Lin Mansion, he can take revenge on Chu Fengmian without any scruples.
"Li Xing, do you think you are really Chu's opponent?"
Chu Fengmian looked at Li Xing with a very amused expression.
"Chu Fengmian, what qualifications do you have to be so arrogant here!"
Seeing Chu Fengmian's expression, Li Xing said angrily that he had already been extremely resentful towards Chu Fengmian. If it weren't for Chu Fengmian, he would have been the butler of the Lin Mansion.
Although he can now be regarded as the number one person in the Lin Mansion, the name of the deputy housekeeper has always been like a thorn in Li Xing's heart, and he has to pull it out countless times.
Now that he heard Chu Fengmian's words, Li Xing could no longer bear it and spoke angrily.
"If you have the ability, come and fight with me on the stage of life and death. It will be clear who is the number one person in the Lin family outside the family!"
"The stage of life and death!"
"This Li Xing actually wants Chu Fengmian to fight him on the stage of life and death!"
The noise coming from the courtyard had already attracted many Lin Mansion disciples to come and watch.
Facing the battle between the Lin Mansion's Chief Steward and Deputy Steward, two people who were almost at the top of the Lin Mansion's Outer Mansion, they were all extremely curious to see who was the number one person in the Lin Mansion's Outer Mansion.
"Although Chu Fengmian has gathered his spiritual veins now and stepped into the realm of a warrior, it only took him a few months at most to gather his spiritual veins. Even with his rapid progress, it is absolutely impossible to fight Li Xing."
A disciple from outside the Lin Mansion shook his head and said.
